title: Teal is the interface brand colour; coral is the mark colour, sourced from --court
context: `--court` aliased `--destructive`, so brand coral had to serve as an error fill, where white text on it reaches only 2.38:1.
decision: Teal `primary` is the interface brand colour. Coral #FC7A56 is the mark colour (the V mark, the recording court, the landing court), and `--court` is its single source token. `--destructive` is derived from `--court`, darker (about hsl(13 85% 42%), 4.83:1 against white text), and no longer equals brand coral.

alternatives.option: Keep coral as both destructive and court
alternatives.reason: Fails AA for white text on every destructive fill.
Loses the brand coral the mark and landing are built on.

consequences: Error and danger surfaces read as a deeper red-orange than the mark.
Landing and recording court stay brand coral because they read --court.
